EmailTemplate.name: Application Decision Declined
EmailTemplate.subject: [{!Account.WCF_Organizational_Name__c}] Update on your Wadhwani Grants application
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Account.FirstName},
Thank you for the time and care you put into your application.
After careful consideration, we’ve decided not to move forward at this time. This reflects our current priorities and the volume of strong applications we receive.
This is not a judgment on the value of your work, and we truly appreciate the opportunity to learn about it.
We’d be glad to stay in touch, and warmly invite you to apply again in the future as our focus evolves.
If you'd like further clarification, feel free to reach us at: [grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org](mailto:grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org)
With appreciation and best wishes, {!Account.PL_of_Record__r} Wadhwani Grants
